title: Software release verification
description: Use for the recurring software release verification workflow in an explicitly authorized project. Do not use for one-off explanation or unapproved execution.
purpose: Verify a bounded software release against the actual repository contract, preserving unrelated changes and recording reproducible evidence.
project_context: Synthetic reference capability; no customer, production environment or previous approval is implied.
source_of_truth: The explicit request and authorized project artifacts; discover their actual locations before execution.
triggers: A request to formalize or repeat this operational workflow.

inputs.name: Release diff
inputs.validation: Identify base/head and account for modified and untracked files.

inputs.name: Acceptance contract
inputs.validation: Find actual test/build commands; do not assume a toolchain.

outputs.name: verification-report.md
outputs.acceptance: Contains scope, revision, actual evidence, unresolved risks and a bounded status.

steps.action: Read the relevant code paths and acceptance criteria, then identify the smallest validation scope.
steps.evidence: File/revision map tied to the requested change.

steps.action: Run the existing failing reproduction or add a regression test without rewriting unrelated code.
steps.evidence: Observed failure or explicitly missing reproduction evidence.

steps.action: Execute relevant unit/integration/build checks with fixtures and scoped permissions.
steps.evidence: Actual command outputs and exit statuses; skipped checks remain unverified.

steps.action: Review authorization, data isolation, migration safety and dependency changes as applicable.
steps.evidence: Risk findings mapped to changed code and negative tests.

steps.action: Prepare release notes and recovery strategy; do not commit, push or publish without authorization.
steps.evidence: Release dossier distinguishing tested behavior from environment assumptions.

checks.criterion: The reported defect has an executed regression check.
checks.method: Replay the reproduction/test and compare outcomes.

checks.criterion: Unrelated user changes are not staged or overwritten.
checks.method: Compare git status/diff before and after.
checks.evidence: Bounded file list with preserved unrelated artifacts.

checks.criterion: The release is not declared production-ready when required integration tests are unavailable.
checks.method: Compare final status against executed-check inventory.
checks.evidence: Explicit NOT_TESTED/BLOCKED items and release decision.

constraints: Do not copy credentials, private client facts or unrelated memory into this capability.
Do not infer authorization from a task description, a role prompt or a passing test.
Do not invent executed checks, performance metrics or human approvals.
approvals: Material external side effects, destructive changes, publication and privilege expansion need explicit contextual approval.

decisions.when: A migration drops data without recovery evidence
decisions.then: Block promotion and obtain a tested migration/recovery strategy.

assumptions: This is a synthetic reusable example, not a completed production run.
pending: Bind the workflow to an authorized project and verify its external tool contracts before execution.

files.purpose: Record an evidence-backed report without fabricated defaults.
files.origin: Original synthetic template authored for this boilerplate.
files.content:
# Verification report template

This is a template, not an execution record.

## Scope and revision
Record actual scope and revision.

## Executed checks
For each check: source, command/method, observed result and evidence location.

## Not tested or blocked
Record missing dependencies and why no result is claimed.

## Risk and decision
Distinguish technical recommendation from human authorization.
